summary: Fix finite ProductSet-to-FiniteSet subset and equality comparisons, including finite Range factors, and implement guarded finite rewriting. Proper subset/superset now use mutual inclusion rather than structural inequality. Equality simplification handles non-arithmetic operands without subtracting sets. Added regression coverage for equal/unequal representations, symbolic unknowns, finite ranges, nested products, infinite/noniterable products, and symbolic range rewriting. Reproduced original None subset and Complement.equals crash; new regression failed before fix. Public bin/test suites sympy/sets/tests, sympy/core/tests/test_relational.py, and sympy/simplify/tests/test_simplify.py passed: 302 passed, 1 skipped, 9 expected failures. git diff --check passed. Only assigned broker used; no external access or subagents.
